competitors.title: Context Layer for AI Agents: Enterprise Guide 2026
key_points: Only 7% of enterprises say their data is completely ready for AI (Cloudera + HBR, March 2026)
A context layer sits between enterprise data systems and AI agents, translating raw metadata into governed business meaning
Four failure modes: meaning fragments across systems, tribal knowledge, identity resolution conflicts, untraceable answers
Five-layer architecture: semantic layer, ontology, operational playbooks, lineage, active metadata
OpenAI's internal data agent reduced query time from 22 min to 1 min 22 sec with full context stack
Atlan MCP server delivers context to agents across Cursor, Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, VS Code
Gartner predicts 60% of agentic analytics projects relying solely on MCP will fail by 2028 without semantic layer underneath

competitors.title: Semantic Layer: Ground Enterprise AI in 5 Steps (June 2026)
key_points: Semantic layer is an intermediate platform that sits between data sources and applications
Abstracts complex data structures into unified, machine-readable glossary of business terms
5-step blueprint: define metrics layer, establish governed context schema, map data sources, connect to AI agent, implement automated fact-checking
Can reuse existing BI semantic layers from Tableau, PowerBI via modern APIs
Semantic layer tooling: dbt, Cube, Looker, AtScale
Targeted pilot can be deployed in 4-6 weeks for top 20 business metrics

competitors.title: Active Metadata: How Modern Catalogs Power AI Agents in 2026
key_points: Active metadata transitions from static documentation to continuous intelligence system
Core capabilities: real-time sync, automated discovery, ML-driven profiling, column-level lineage, policy automation
Knowledge graphs capture richer relational context for entity-relationship grounding
Active lineage enables 50-70% faster incident resolution
Gartner predicts active metadata will decrease time to delivery of new data assets by up to 70%
Promethium 360° Context Hub: aggregating metadata from catalogs, BI tools, and semantic layers

competitors.title: Knowledge Catalog for AI Agents (Google Cloud, June 2026)
key_points: Knowledge Catalog provides a unified map linking physical data assets with business semantics and governance rules
Grounds AI agents with reliable, up-to-date, contextual metadata
Supports both remote MCP server and local MCP toolbox for agent integration
Data insights feature (powered by Gemini in BigQuery) auto-generates descriptions, relationship graphs, and example queries
Custom enrichment agents can ingest metadata from internal wikis, code repos, and proprietary systems

competitors.title: Agentic Data Management: The Next Step for Enterprise Data (IBM, Feb 2026)
key_points: Agentic data management uses AI agents to manage end-to-end data flow across distributed environments
Agents draw on metadata, lineage, machine learning, and business rules to determine data relevance
Moves workflows beyond static scripts into adaptive, context-aware behavior
Enterprise agents must understand governed business meaning, not just access raw data
